title: Fiery Nether Portals
description: This resource pack makes the nether portal look fiery
body:
🔥 **Fiery Nether Portal** 🔥

✨ **Features:**

* Replaces the default portal texture with a **lava-inspired, fiery design**
* Keeps the classic portal animation but with an **infernal twist**
* Works seamlessly in survival and multiplayer
* Lightweight and performance-friendly

🔥 **Extra Details:**

* Designed to pair perfectly with shaders for an even more intense glow
* Still compatible with vanilla-style packs
* Great for Nether-themed builds

---
